text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is about to kick
off! The
Umamusume selected by fan
vote will soon take
each other on here at
Hanshin Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Of course, special attention is fixed on
the battle
between the Empress, Air
Groove, and the
Otherworldly
Front-Runner, Сайленс Судзука!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Everyone is on the edge of their seats,
itching to
see them face off!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Who do you think'll win? Эйр Грув or
Silence
Suzuka?
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text:
Whoever wins, one thing's for sure—it's
gonna be
a crazy intense race!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
As Эйр Грув makes her way to the
track...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(She's come a long way since our
scrimmage.
She's... extraordinary.)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I don't plan on losing either.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(I can't afford to lose... There's no way I
can lose!)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If I can't, then that means... Suzuka's
running
really is...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
